notes: BRAND-APPLICABILITY CAVEAT (ships with the caveat on file): the page states the styles found for Fedders-Airwell are being used here and that, although unconfirmed, it is believed all Fedders-Airwell units use these styles. This caveat goes to applicability scope, not to the accuracy of the shipped rule, so it ships with the caveat recorded. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: Style 1 (EW020144126H: week = 3rd-4th characters, year = 5th-6th characters, both text-verified) is HELD on shape collision — its shape ^[A-Z]{2}\d{9}[A-Z]$ is identical to held chart-only Style 3 (AS298488006X), so a serial of that shape could be either system and Style 1 decoding would mis-decode a Style 3 serial; see report for the judgment call. Style 3 (month = 1st character chart, year = 2nd character chart), Style 4 (month = 1st character chart, year = 2nd character chart) and Style 5 (month = 2nd-to-last character chart, year = last character chart) are held as chart-only, pending the image pass. Counting: Style 1 and Style 2 state positions as 'characters', so character counting governs; the digit-only reading of Style 1 (week 01, year 44) is falsified by the page's own italic grouping EW*0201*44126H.

styles.era: 8-character serials (2 digits, letter, 5 digits), year only
styles.notes: Page example 02J-60002. Year = 1st-2nd characters (0-based [0,2]) = '02' -> 2002. Month = 3rd character, chart-only, so year-only. Shape is disjoint from every held style on this page (Style 3/4 start with letters, Style 5 is 7 characters).
